test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If P can complete { {1} over 3} of a work in 6 days and Q can complete {{1} over 4} of the same work in 9 days, how much will Q get if both work together and are paid in advance ₹210 in all?
solution:
**Given:**

P can complete 1/3rd of the work in 6 days 

Q can complete 1/4th of the work in 9 days

**Formula used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

P can complete whole work = 3 x 6 = 18 days

Q can complete whole work = 4 x 9 = 36 days

Let the total work be 36 units (LCM of 18 & 36)

⇒ Efficiency of P = 36/18 = 2

⇒ Efficiency of Q = 36/36 = 1

Money is divided in the ratio of efficiency

⇒ Pay of Q = 210 × 1/3 = 70

**∴ The pay of Q is ₹****70.**
